decision: Does a fixed causal prefix of 16 prior portable policy roots add episode-stable h16 physical-HIT prediction and current-action discrimination on low-propensity, known-nonbaseline, and pre-first-HIT rows after current-root weighting failed?

evaluation.use: single post-selection evaluation on already observed L2d episodes; may select fresh confirmation but is not independent evidence

gate.candidate_probability_surface: history-full raw clipped fraction is at most 0.001; comparator clipping is reported but is not a candidate rejection
gate.current_action_signal: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for history-full minus current-action-ablated-history Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.history_temporal_gain: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for history-full minus same-row current-only Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.low_propensity_action_signal: behavior-propensity-below-0.025 rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have history-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions
gate.nonbaseline_action_signal: known-nonbaseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have history-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have history-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions

hypotheses.H1_temporal_information: If the portable current root aliases TH06 phase or unknown-birth state, 16 causal prior policy roots will improve h16 Brier over a current-only model of identical capacity fit on the same rows.
hypotheses.H2_current_action_increment: If history resolves state ambiguity rather than merely predicting route risk, history-full will beat the same history with exactly the nine current action-relative fields removed.
hypotheses.H3_exploration_support: The current-action increment remains on the bulk below propensity 0.025 and on actions known to differ from the reactive baseline.
hypotheses.H4_lifecycle: The current-action increment remains before the first physical HIT and is not supported only by post-HIT lifecycle state.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: All L2d episodes and earlier hazard results have already been inspected. Passing may select an immutable history scorer for wholly fresh confirmation only; it cannot independently confirm, establish causal action value, promote a policy, or authorize value learning.

non_goals: no history-length, architecture, target, horizon, tree-count, depth, optimizer, regularization, weighting, calibration-family, or hyperparameter sweep
no new Wine episode, corpus mutation, padding, prior outcome, HIT/lifecycle input, object set, recurrent state, critic, actor, RL, IQL, CQL, OPE, active collection, or counterfactual successor
no behavior propensity, baseline identity, absolute frame, stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, run identity, source, or future fact as a model input
no invented successor for an unexecuted action: the current target and every past action come from factual executed Wine transitions
no causal action-effect, long-horizon action-value, HIT-reduction, NMNB, independent-confirmation, or online-execution claim
